_comment: Engine registry for oh-my-hummod. Copy this file to 'engines.json' and
fill in the folders where YOUR engine builds live. 'engines.json' is
git-ignored, so your local paths stay local.
Pin the profile when menu-based detection cannot tell two builds apart.
HumMod-BAT and Clemmer Salt 3.0.4 ship the SAME HumMod.EXE, so 'bat'
The 'default' key is taken from the HUMMOD_ENGINE_DIR environment
variable and does not belong here.
The profile is detected from the engine folder's VERSION file, or from
the live top-level menu - never from the EXE name (several builds ship
the same HumMod.EXE). Builds without a VERSION file whose menu matches
another build (BAT, AVP) MUST pin their profile here.
HUMMOD_ENGINES (a JSON string in the environment) can extend or
override this registry for one server process - handy for pointing a
test run at a copied engine folder without touching engines.json.
